macros.name: allinethickness
macros.doc: Set the line thickness of all line drawing commands including lines in any slopes, circles, ellipsis, arcs, ovals and splines.

macros.name: ellipse
macros.doc: The command \ellipse draws an ellipse by specifying the x-diameter and y-diameter.

macros.name: Thicklines
macros.doc: With the \Thicklines declaration, thickness of lines drawn will be about 1.5 times of \thicklines.
